judges: S.C. Das Counsel For The J.
trial_court: Family Court, West Tripura, Title Suit (RCR) No. 155 of 2012
case_name: Smt. Anita Deb (Nandi) vs Dr. Mahadeo Sitaram Joshi
facts_of_case: The parties are separated and the respondent-husband seeks restituting conjugal rights against the appellant-wife. The case centers around the correct procedure to be adopted by the Family Court in examining the parties.

legal_principles.principle: The role of the Counsellor and Presiding Officer is to ensure that a party, especially a woman, is given legal aid if they are unable to present their case properly.
legal_principles.held: If the Presiding Officer feels that any party, more specially the woman, is unable to present her case in a proper manner due to the reason of illiteracy or otherwise, it is the duty of the Counsellor and the Family Court to ensure that the woman is given legal aid by providing a legal aid counsel to her.
cited_cases: Mat. Appeal No. 2 of 2009 (Smt. Anjana Dey (Mandal) v. Shri Subal Mandal)
Leela Mahadeo Joshi vs. Dr. Mahadeo Sitaram Joshi, [AIR 1991 BOMBAY 105]
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — to ensure fair representation of parties in family courts

legal_principles.principle: Mechanically following Section 13 and rejecting the prayer for assistance of counsel is not proper.
legal_principles.held: Mechanically following Section 13 and rejecting the prayer for assistance of counsel is not proper.
cited_cases: Mat. Appeal No. 2 of 2009 (Smt. Anjana Dey (Mandal) v. Shri Subal Mandal)
Leela Mahadeo Joshi vs. Dr. Mahadeo Sitaram Joshi, [AIR 1991 BOMBAY 105]
legal_principles.significance: MEDIUM — to highlight the importance of considering the need for legal aid in family courts

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the order of the trial court is set aside.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
